failureMatrix: Organization acceptance/leave: blocked temporary path preserves disk and in-memory roster, pending invitation remains retryable.
New game at catalog limit: no match or selection is published; pruning completed history enables retry.
Bid reservation: failed save preserves exact prior bytes; retry escrows credits once.
Order reservation: failed save preserves auction state; retry reserves ore/credits/parts once.
Compensation completion: failed save preserves RUNNING order; restart/retry refunds once and conserves all three resources.
Corrupt event list: restore, step and manager prune all reject without altering the corrupted bytes.
Unauthorized reset: participants and outsiders cannot delete shared history; managers cannot delete an active game.
